jobs_results.title: HR Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Description
• Location within Spain Operations Site Location can be reconsidered according to candidate and company needs. *

At Amazon, we are always exploring new opportunities to shape our global business. As an HR Project Manager within PXT team at Amazon, you'll contribute to the success of Amazon’s employee experience, including Associates, Leaders and peers.

Key job responsibilities

-Project and Program Implementation: Lead the launch and monitoring of HR programs, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure successful implementation.

-Operational Optimization: Use data to identify operational challenges, proposing and implementing continuous improvement initiatives to enhance employee experience.

-Collaborative Practices: Work closely with different Amazon departments, sharing and adopting best practices within a program environment to support Spain Operational Sites.

-Stakeholder Engagement: Manage internal processes, define standards, and work collaboratively... with a multidisciplinary teams to overcome operational challenges.

A day in the life

As Project Manager, your role involves planning, implementing, and improving projects and initiatives to enhance the overall employee experience. Collaborating closely with various Amazon teams and stakeholders, you'll coordinate and execute program implementation and continuous improvement, ensuring seamless operations within the Spain Operational Sites.

About the team

At Amazon, our HR department plays a vital role in looking after our people. Known as the People Experience and Technology Solutions (PXT) team, our priority is making the Amazon experience brilliant for our people, helping us remain one of the world’s most innovative, customer-centric and nimble businesses.

We operate proactively and take a holistic approach to people management. Our team is ‘Customer Obsessed’ and focuses on solving employee engagement issues quickly, ensuring nothing impacts our seamless employee and customer experience. Ultimately, it’s our job to insist on the highest standards and drive progress across Amazon’s strategy and goals.

We are open to hiring candidates to work out of one of the following locations:

Barcelona, ESP | Dos Hermanas, SE, ESP | Girona, ESP | Illescas, TO, ESP | Murcia, MU, ESP | Onda, ESP | San Fernando De Henares, ESP | Valladolid, VA, ESP | Zaragoza, Z, ESP

Basic Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree
• Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, V-LookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
• Experience in program or project management
• Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
• Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics
• Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
• Advanced Proficiency in English and Spanish.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
• Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
• Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates

jobs_results.title: Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
• *Project Manager**
• *Location: Bristol (Hybrid)**

This is a hybrid position primarily based in Bristol. We're committed to your flexibility and wellbeing and our hybrid strategy currently requires two days a week in the office, giving you the option to work remotely for some of your working week. Find out more about our culture of flexible working.
• *We give you a world of potential**

Computershare Plan Managers (CPM) is the division within Computershare responsible for providing administrative services, project management and plan design to Plan Manager clients and their individual employee share plan holders. Plans Implementation is the team within CPM that Implements share plans for new or existing clients.

The Project Manager role operates within this team at a regional level to deliver projects that implement new share plans within agreed timeframes and quality standards in accordance with client expectations, project management process and regulatory... guidelines.

The Project Manager is expected to work collaboratively with external clients and across teams within the same region, supporting continuous improvement activity related to the role.

The Project Manager is responsible for the delivery to the defined scope, and quality of share plan implementation projects with medium complexity (as per the Computershare Project Complexity Assessment Model) for clients of Computershare Plan Managers. Projects involve external clients as well as multiple internal teams within Computershare.

The Project Manager works closely with relevant internal stakeholders to ensure all project activity is actioned in order to meet deadlines and deliver the anticipated benefits to the business and client satisfaction.

In addition the role holder will also manage client expectations, negotiate for internal resource and provide appropriate level of reporting and documentation for governance, quality and regulatory requirements.
• *A role you will love**

- Deliver multiple client facing projects with a medium level of complexity to the agreed scope, quality, timeline and budget to the satisfaction of all stakeholders
- Create detailed plans for the project and implement monitoring, control and reporting processes using Key Decision Points to ensure that the project realises the benefits.
- Manage quality and detail of stakeholder requirements to build customer confidence, create long-lasting relationships and meet customers' needs.
- Influence and manage expectations of senior project stakeholders; both internal and external. Independently discuss service offering for at least two of our plan types and supporting services. Deliver clear and timely communications.
- Create the project governance, organisational structure and outline clear roles and responsibilities for all workstreams and sub-projects.
- Work closely with the Project Management Office (PMO) to ensure alignment of priorities, optimum resource usage and effective communication.
- Manage, lead, direct and motivate a medium project team.
- Ensure business readiness for supporting and ongoing administration of new share plans, products and services following project delivery; ensure formal closure of projects with review/lessons learned meetings with internal and external stakeholders.
• *What will you bring to the role?**

- Proven experience of managing, leading and delivering projects with medium complexity
- Proven track record of delivering projects into an Operational environment with the financial services industry.
- Proven capability and expertise in Project delivery competencies: Delivery planning, risk and issue management, quality management, project reviews, change control, benefits and knowledge management.
- Project Managers will have 1-2 years' experience of managing projects in a related or similar environment.
- Particularly Microsoft Office (Word, Visio, Excel, PowerPoint) and MS Project with the ability to produce high quality written documentation, including reports, presentations slides & project plans.
- Able to analyse complex requirements, balance the needs of both internal and external customers, manage risks and issues, and prioritise based on benefits.
- Understand both the process for onboarding of new share plans and our service offering.
- Manage the onboarding of one or more plans for a client for projects with medium complexity.
- Can independently discuss and present the CPM Onboarding process.
- Manage medium project teams consisting of internal and external staff to help them deliver the project objectives. Contribute to the project management team by sharing experiences, helping other team members with issues and contributing to knowledge management and continuous improvement activities.
- Competent people skills - able to motivate team members to deliver in challenging situations.
- Create and present a vision and set direction, that motivates others to work towards a common goal.
- Influence decisions with both internal and external stakeholders
- Establish and develop productive relationships with internal and external stakeholders, bringing people together to benefit the project.
- Own decisions and be accountable for decisions made and the output from the project.
- Ensure the project team is working to full capacity, making best use of available resource.
- Give feedback on project team performance, individual and as a whole.
- Recognise and anticipate existing or potential conflicts at an individual or team level.
- Recognise problems and respond, systematically gather information, sort through complex issues, seek input from others, address root cause of issues, makes timely decisions, and communicates to others.
- Able to work in an environment of uncertainty and continual change. Able to feel comfortable making decisions and setting direction without having the full picture and re-focus as details emerge. Can apply knowledge and techniques to reduce ambiguity. Be open to new ideas and adjust plans to meet changing needs.
- Manage and lead a network of senior stakeholders both internal and external.
- Confident in dealing with external stakeholders e.g., executive level contacts at our clients and/or their vendors.
- Challenge senior stakeholders to ensure solutions are beneficial to the project/ company.
- able to build relationships and deal with challenging situations.
- Able to articulate information clearly and concisely via meetings, presentations, and workshops.
- Confident in dealing with senior management and executives across all areas of the business.
- Can tailor communications to suit different levels of audiences.
- Can present insights from data in engaging and impactful ways.
• *ABOUT US**
• *A company to be proud of**

We're a global leader in financial administration with over 14,000 employees across more than 21 different countries. At Computershare, it's more than just a job, our open and inclusive culture means that we will help you to grow, to move forward and make the most of our world of opportunities.
• *A diverse and inclusive place to work**

Computershare celebrate the diversity of our people, and we welcome applications from everyone. We believe that having a culture of inclusion is essential in delivering good results. Attracting, retaining, and developing a diverse workforce where employees feel valued, respected, and empowered allows people to reach their full potential. As a business this diversity helps us to better reflect and understand our customers' needs to allow us to drive better outcomes.

We are happy to accommodate individual needs during your application journey. If you require disability accommodations or adjustments, please email us at **TalentAcquisition@computershare.com** detailing your requirements and contact information.

Computershare is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national or ethnic origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by applicable law.
• *ABOUT THE TEAM**

We're a leading provider of employee share plans. We partner with many of the world's biggest brands to offer their employees the chance to invest in the future of their company and help them to manage these investments day to day. With over 35 years of experience and expertise, we're an industry leader. Every member of our team plays an important role in bringing to life employee share plans, providing innovative solutions and assisting our clients with their complex regulatory requirements

jobs_results.title: Customer Project Specialist - Spain
jobs_results.description:
Program Start Date: September 2024

 

Location: Spain

The Internet of Everything is a phenomenon driving new opportunities for Cisco and it's transforming our customers' businesses worldwide. We are pioneers and have been since the early days of connectivity. Today, we are building teams that are expanding our technology solutions in the mobile, cloud, security, IT, and big data spaces, including software and consulting services. As Cisco delivers the network that powers the Internet, we are connecting the unconnected. Imagine creating unprecedented disruption. Your revolutionary ideas will impact everything from retail, healthcare, and entertainment, to public and private sectors, and far beyond. Collaborate with like-minded innovators in a fun and flexible culture that has earned Cisco global recognition as a Great Place To Work. With roughly 10 billion connected things in the world now and over 50 billion estimated in the future, your career has exponential possibilities at... Cisco. 

So if your desire to work in leading-edge technology is matched by your drive to make a difference then the Associate Project Manager (aPM) role is the right challenge for you. 

What you will do as Associate Project Manager: 

In this role you’ll be part of an actively growing Professional Services (PS) team. The Cisco Professional Services organization helps customers optimize their network investment and speed adoption and migration of advanced technologies. A key component of the PS portfolio is our Project Management/ Business Development Management capability and expertise. While your career will be developing some travel may be required. You’d be provided with training in your first months, followed by hands-on training on projects assisted by an experienced Cisco Project Manager/ Business Development Manager. 

For Associate Project Manager, day to day that means: 
• Successful completion of customer projects ensuring that the project objectives, customer acceptance criteria and internal performance metrics are achieved. 
• Ensuring compliance with legislation and regulatory requirements such as H&S, compliance with contractual obligations, ISO certification requirements and Cisco policies and processes at all times. 
• Managing internal and external stakeholders, subcontractor partners and project team members and ensuring the accuracy of project data in internal tools and systems. 
• Assisting program managers or senior project managers in performing project administration activities. 

What we can offer you: 
• Understanding of core Project Management knowledge areas according to PMI with focus on the triple constraint: time-scope/quality-cost.
• Opportunity to shadow technology professionals and understand a broad range of Cisco Technologies
• Opportunity to earn Cisco and Industry Certifications (CCNA, CAPM)
• Interaction with Cisco employees and clients all over the world
• A competitive salary and generous benefits
• Being part of a diverse and international team composed by people with different backgrounds and areas of expertise
• Dedicate part of your time to lead/be part of Cisco’s internal initiatives where you can deliver results by applying your creativity and motivation to make the difference

Programme structure:
• First 3 months (together with all APMs from EMEAR): full-time virtual training, shadowing and job rotation.
• After 3 months: join the local CX team in your home country for which you have applied for. 

What you will need to be eligible for the aPM role: 
• You are a recent graduate or on your final year of studies towards a degree or related program or other academic certification; equivalent experience accepted in lieu of degree
• You are able to live and work in Spain with no additional VISA sponsorship from Cisco 
• You are fluent in English and Spanish
• Language proficiency in Portuguese, German, French, Italian or Arabic is beneficial
• Project management (ex. CAPM, PMP, PRINCE2) and/or ITIL certification is a great plus 
• You are able to begin full time employment in September 2024

What skills you will need to succeed: 
• You have strong organizational and leadership skills 
• You have interest in technology and understand technical issues, and can leverage technical expertise of others 
• You produce quality work under pressure with immediate deadlines 
• You are able to adjust in rapidly changing environment and to prioritize your activities/set the right expectations with your internal and external stakeholders.
• You have written, verbal communication skills, with the ability to present to large groups with confidence

jobs_results.title: Crisis & Incident Management Program Manager
jobs_results.description:
POSITION DETAILS

Position Title: Crisis and Incident Management Program Manager

Department: Security

Location: Malakoff, France; Redhill, UK, Barcelona, Spain or Shannon, Ireland

POSITION SUMMARY

The ambition of the security organization is to evolve to a business partner role, delivering value to the business while reducing and managing their risk. This by following a risk-based strategy and security improvement program with common objectives and controls.

The Crisis and Incident Management Program Manager is a part of Central team, and is a key discipline within Operational Resilience department to ensure that Business Continuity, IT Service Continuity, and Crisis & Incident management within the AXA Partners countries is defined, implemented, and delivered in accordance with the Group Security Strategy and supports to achieve local maturity objectives in cost-effective manner.

DIMENSIONS OF ROLE

As Crisis and Incident Management Program Manager, you will be part of the... central Operational Resilience team and, reporting directly to Chief Operational Resilience Officer, while working closely with Operational resilience community including local Incident Management teams across AXA Partners countries located in Europe, North America, and LATAM.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· Support the AXA Partners Crisis Coordinator in advancing the Crisis and Incident management Group framework and controls globally.

· Achieve incident and crisis management maturity targets with effective controls in place.

· Collaborate with local incident management teams to ensure the implementation of proper incident management structures and processes, including high-risk scenario testing, event logs, incident logs, post-mortem analysis, and remedial action plans.

· Consolidate and present risks and gaps to the Operational Resilience steering committee.

· Assist with internal and external audit requests and assurance reviews, and support the crisis coordinator during major incidents and crises.

· Provide oversight across all disciplines for the Chief Operational Resilience Officer, including crisis and incident management controls, global documentation, strategy, and implementation in countries.

· Collaborate with and support the Group Security Practice, interacting with various stakeholders to ensure the effectiveness of processes and controls.

· Advise local countries on the implementation and maintenance of incident/crisis management processes and controls, and support Regional Security Managers in their Operational Resilience activities.

· Ensure the implementation of policies, shared security services, and action plans based on the Group Security Strategy.

· Identify and analyze risks, recommend mitigation options, and ensure the quality and consistency of reporting and action plans produced at both local and regional levels.

Your Profile

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

You have a Bachelor's degree in computer science, management information systems or information security. You have several years of experience working in the security field and you have a strong understanding of business continuity, IT service continuity, and crisis/incident management practices and standards, including DRII, BCI materials, ISO 22301, and 22316. Awareness of relevant regulations, particularly in DORA, is advantageous. Experience in business continuity, IT service continuity, crisis and incident management, security risk analysis, and information security is essential, with additional experience in the financial/insurance/assistance industry being beneficial. You are proficient in data management and reporting tools, fluent in English (with additional languages such as French or Spanish being an asset), excellent problem-solving abilities, and the capacity to plan and execute projects are crucial. You can work autonomously and you possess strong interpersonal and communication skills. Experience with ClearView, SendWordNow, and SharePoint is a plus.

#LI-UK

Join a company that helps protect the forests! At AXA Partners, we plant a tree for every new recruit (with a permanent contract). Learn more about the Reforest Program here.

About AXA

AXA Group is the world leader in insurance and asset management. We protect and advise our clients at every step in their lives, by offering products and services which satisfy their needs in the areas of insurance, personal protection, saving and asset management. AXA is the leading insurance brand worldwide, with over 100 million clients. We are transforming from payer to partner for our client, with a strong focus on risk prevention.

Our mission: Empower people to live a better life.

Our values: Customer First, Courage, Integrity and One AXA.

About the Entity

AXA Partners is an AXA transversal business unit offering a wide range of solutions in assistance services, travel insurance and credit protection.

AXA Partners’ role is also to implement innovative solutions emerging from the AXA Innovation unit.

Combining passion with advanced expertise, we design and deliver worldwide solutions for partners and communities. We protect what matters, when it matters.

Join a company that helps protect the forests! At AXA Partners, we plant a tree for every new recruit (with a permanent contract).

What We Offer

At AXA Partners, we’re appreciative of the people who work for us and our rewards package is reviewed regularly to reflect that. You can expect to receive:

Competitive annual salary
Annual company & performance-based bonus
Group Personal Pension Plan
Life Assurance (4x Annual Salary)
Private Healthcare Benefit
AXA employee discounts

We look for candidates with the right skills and values to join us and selection is based on a fair and equal process. We’re committed to providing equal opportunities for all, therefore we welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds

The ambition of the security organization is to evolve to a business partner role, delivering value to the business while reducing and managing their risk. This by following a risk-based strategy and security improvement program with common objectives and controls.

The Crisis and Incident Management Program Manager is a part of Central team, and is a key discipline within Operational Resilience department to ensure that Business Continuity, IT Service Continuity, and Crisis & Incident management within the AXA Partners countries is defined, implemented, and delivered in accordance with the Group Security Strategy and supports to achieve local maturity objectives in cost-effective manner.

DIMENSIONS OF ROLE

As Crisis and Incident Management Program Manager, you will be part of the... central Operational Resilience team and, reporting directly to Chief Operational Resilience Officer, while working closely with Operational resilience community including local Incident Management teams across AXA Partners countries located in Europe, North America, and LATAM.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· Support the AXA Partners Crisis Coordinator in advancing the Crisis and Incident management Group framework and controls globally.

· Achieve incident and crisis management maturity targets with effective controls in place.

· Collaborate with local incident management teams to ensure the implementation of proper incident management structures and processes, including high-risk scenario testing, event logs, incident logs, post-mortem analysis, and remedial action plans.

· Consolidate and present risks and gaps to the Operational Resilience steering committee.

· Assist with internal and external audit requests and assurance reviews, and support the crisis coordinator during major incidents and crises.

· Provide oversight across all disciplines for the Chief Operational Resilience Officer, including crisis and incident management controls, global documentation, strategy, and implementation in countries.

· Collaborate with and support the Group Security Practice, interacting with various stakeholders to ensure the effectiveness of processes and controls.

· Advise local countries on the implementation and maintenance of incident/crisis management processes and controls, and support Regional Security Managers in their Operational Resilience activities.

· Ensure the implementation of policies, shared security services, and action plans based on the Group Security Strategy.

· Identify and analyze risks, recommend mitigation options, and ensure the quality and consistency of reporting and action plans produced at both local and regional levels.

Your Profile

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

You have a Bachelor's degree in computer science, management information systems or information security. You have several years of experience working in the security field and you have a strong understanding of business continuity, IT service continuity, and crisis/incident management practices and standards, including DRII, BCI materials, ISO 22301, and 22316. Awareness of relevant regulations, particularly in DORA, is advantageous. Experience in business continuity, IT service continuity, crisis and incident management, security risk analysis, and information security is essential, with additional experience in the financial/insurance/assistance industry being beneficial. You are proficient in data management and reporting tools, fluent in English (with additional languages such as French or Spanish being an asset), excellent problem-solving abilities, and the capacity to plan and execute projects are crucial. You can work autonomously and you possess strong interpersonal and communication skills. Experience with ClearView, SendWordNow, and SharePoint is a plus.

jobs_results.title: Owner's Engineering Wind Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
The Project Manager will lead the delivery of wind OE consultancy projects worldwide and ensure they are delivered on time, on budget and with zero errors. This includes coordination of internal MM, and external resource where needed, deliverable review and acceptance, budget and time adherence, client liaison, and internal reporting on wind OE projects. The role will also involve the preparation of bids for new work.
The Project Manager is ideally an engineer or other technically educated professional conversant in wind turbine technologies and market conditions, such that in this client facing role, the PM is able to guide technical discussions and make recommendations.

As part of our global team you will be responsible for:
• Supporting major wind project developments internationally.
• Providing engineering input from initial assessment through to technical and economic feasibility, construction monitoring and acceptance.
• Reviewing and preparing technical and non technical... reports to a high standard including specifications, reports, proposals, calculations and contracts.
• Providing technical tender support.
• Actively assisting with business development and client management.
• Attending client and site visits as required (worldwide).
• Reviewing and preparing technical specification and design drawings.
• Working effectively on several projects concurrently to deliver to tight deadlines.
• Support and mentor the career development of junior engineers.

Candidate Specification :
Essential Criteria
• Degree level qualifications in engineering or similar technical subject.
• Demonstrable experience of project management of wind OE projects, either as developer or consultant.
• Excellent IT skills particularly MS Excel/Word/Project and PowerPoint.
• Evidence of technical competence, self-motivation, ability to use own initiative, flexible, problem solving approach.
• Experience of working within a multi-disciplinary engineering environment.
• Ability to communicate clearly & concisely in English, both verbally & written and ability to explain technical issues to non-engineers, including Clients.
• The successful candidate will be required to produce and review technical reports for clients, so attention to detail is paramount.
• Ability to influence and motivate stakeholders within a complex environment,
• Ability to lead/chair and present at meetings etc.
• Able to collate, analyse and act upon complex and diverse information from a variety of sources and give advice for project level decision making.

Desirable criteria
• Experience in consultancy environment, and in a client facing role.
• Ability to work in a second language.
• Willingness to travel both locally and globally.
• Recognised Project Management training.

We are actively recruiting a diverse workforce that is reflective of the communities we serve. We recognise that differences in ability, skills and experience are a strength and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds.

 

Mott MacDonald

Our purpose is to improve society by considering social outcomes in everything we do, relentlessly focusing on excellence and digital innovation, transforming our clients’ businesses, our communities and employee opportunities.

A fundamental part of this is respecting each person’s differences and striving to meet their needs.

Our values: Progress, Respect, Integrity, Drive, Excellence.

Equality, diversity, and inclusion

We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels they can contribute.

We want you to perform your best at every stage in the recruitment process. If you are disabled or need any support to enable you to apply or attend an interview, please contact us at reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com and we will talk to you about how we can support you.

Agile working

Happy to talk Flexible Working and how we can support your responsibilities beyond the workplace.

We offer some fantastic benefits including:
• Life insurance 
• An annual professional institution subscription  
• Continuous development opportunities – because we want you to thrive 
• Agile/flexible working – because life isn’t 9-5 
• Enhanced parental leave

jobs_results.title: CEE IT Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: European Union

Job Description & Summary

Overview

We’re looking for an IT Project Manager who would be responsible for managing and delivering our internal IT projects within the CEE region in a fast paced and evolving technology environment.

He/she will also be part of our Project Management Office helping us govern the projects portfolio and our less-experienced colleagues manage their projects successfully.

The ideal candidate will have at least three years experience in IT project management, managing multiple technology-related projects concurrently for various customers and being able to switch the subjects quickly while keeping the deliverables on track.The preferred experience would be with organizational technology migrations.

Our focus is to find a self-organized and proactive individual with a passion for technology and a strong desire to drive value delivery and continuous improvement.

This position is available... in remote mode with occasional travel to the office based on the project needs.

Key responsibilities:

Project Management (80% FTE)
• Manage and coordinate internal IT projects in the CEE region, including infrastructure implementations, software development, and automations.
• Ensure overall ownership and accountability of end-to-end project delivery and management, from project initiation to closure.
• Utilize standard best practices in project management with a focus on value delivery and continuous improvement.

Project Management Office Governance (20% FTE):
• Assist with governance of the CEE IT Projects portfolio, maintain up-to-date information, define standards and provide training.
• Ensure compliance with PMO standards and best practices by IT Project Managers.
• Proactively identify and resolve issues and seize opportunities to improve our operations.
• Provide valuable insights for the leadership.

PM Experience
• 3-5 years in IT Project Management
• Management and ownership of entire project lifecycle
• Preferred experience with technology migrations
• Project management certification welcome (PMI/Prince)

IT Skills
• General IT background with passion for new technologies and ability to rapidly acquire knowledge and proficiency in new areas
• Familiarity with industry-standard IT corporate solutions.

Personal skills
• Self-organized person with passion for technology and drive to get things done
• Mature with low level of supervision needed
• Able to work under pressure and tight deadlines
• Proactive, agile and value-driven
• Ability to multitask and prioritize

Language:
• English - required

Travel:
• 0-25% within CEE

jobs_results.title: Project Manager - Order-to-Cash (Unify)
jobs_results.description:
Schneider has started a journey to UNIFY its Business Processes (across the different Business Model – Transactional, Projects, Service, Software) in order to;
• Simplify the life of our people.
• Standardize our business processes and IT landscape to react and scale faster
• Harmonize our data foundations to drive better decisions
• Enhance our customers’ and suppliers’ digital journeys

This major project, which is sponsored and driven by the Excom to design and implement the way Schneider will operate over the next 20 years, will involve hundreds of stakeholders and needs very strong coordination and stakeholder management.

We have decided to deploy the Fit2Standard approach with the following steps :
• Leverage SAP process map as a starting point
• Together with Order2Cash / GSC / Finance and Data Unify Domains, extend them to cover an End2End scope covering the complete digital and data architecture (ERP + Global apps)
• Engage with countries to review, adopt and validate what... will become the Schneider global standard processes to drive our business

The Order to Cash Template Project Manager is the catalyst of the Template of the Unify Fit2Standard solution with BPOs and SAP. He/She will make sure that all actions are planned and executed in full coordination with Stream Leaders; SAP expert and our Global BPOs. He/she will participate in all interactions with BPOs to measure the level of alignment, define the development needs / corrective actions and contribute to the creation of the Order to Cash Template.

He/she is accountable for planning, preparation and co-ordination of the Order to Cash UNIFY Template, consisting of the Business Processes, Specifications for ERP, Integration specification and links to Best of Breed solution to ensure Unify is successfully implemented.

Missions
• Prepare and implement the Order to Cash Template across all Business Streams; Transactional, Projects, Equipment, Service & Software, defined details and planning actions & resources needed
• Together with Stream Leaders, BPOs and SAP experts plan, implement, anticipate risks and manage all dependencies relative to the Order to Cash Template
• Become the trusted advisor for BPOs during the Template creation
• Coordinate and bring the voice of BPOs and SAP experts to the central team. Bring the point of concerns and development needed

Responsibilities
• Coordinates/monitor the Order to Cash Template for the deployment. Define the actions to make the BPOs and SAP are ready and animate accordingly.
• Readiness
• Assessment of the GAP between target standard solution
• Acknowledge the digital landscape: integration, data & SAP expertise
• Support the profiling and the placement of the needed resources and make sure they are staffed in each Domain/Business Unit
• Consolidates the status updates for Order to Cash Template for all Domains and Businesses to be presented to the Order to Cash Leaders.
• Prepare and execute the communication plan with all stakeholders
• Align program team on expectations / deliverables / priorities
• Coordination and facilitation of the BPOs engagement plan for the selected Streams
• Participate to the interviews with Individual interviews to validate business requirements and integration specifications
• Participate to key Workshops together with SAP Experts, SE Process Leads and Schneider Digital Product Managers for all streams. Ensure the quality of outputs and consideration of critical points for the standard solution/ Template.
• Overall Template Program plan : Under the functional leadership of the Unify Order to Cash PMO, leverage the Unify Program management tools to plan, implement, manage timelines & identify risks / dependencies for all critical actions aiming at formalizing the Order to Cash Template

Success Profile
• Strong interpersonal communication and presentation skills with a team-oriented approach
• Be able to find the best common solution between different stakeholders, when starting from different opinions
• Ability to work within an international environment, embracing different mindsets
• Capability to directly interact with Senior leaders, both in countries and at Global level
• Ability to find solutions to solve issues (vs. report problems)
• Strong project management skills to follow up on actions points decided after workshops and make sure results are delivered within agreed deadlines
• Strong C-level written communication (incl. Powerpoint re-use skills)
• Understands and leverages cultural differences to make Unify successful
• Excellent at tracking dependencies and plan them with the other Unify teams
• Self-motivated, Energetic, Creative, Confident and able to articulate at multiple levels within an organization.

At Schneider Electric, Diversity & Inclusion is at the heart of our organisation, it's an integral part of our history, culture, and identity. We recognise that embracing diversity unlocks innovation and creativity and fosters collaboration. We want our employees to reflect the diversity of our communities and the customers we serve. As a result, our teams are stronger to drive the company's future.

jobs_results.title: Finance and Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.

Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

Job Description

OVERALL OBJECTIVES

As a Finance and Project Manager, you will take on a leadership role in the Eurofins finance organisation in Spain. The role includes leading Finance Projects (such as integrating... acquired companies), Purchasing, Finance IT, and Payroll, ensuring current and new projects are successfully launched and executed exceptionally well.

POSITION

Leadership and management of three departments, including purchasing, payroll and finance IT, contributing to the successful implementation of new projects:
• Purchasing/procurement
• Develop and implement sourcing strategies in close collaboration with the Group Purchasing and local team.
• Ensure Group-wide reporting on purchasing and the exact calculation of savings obtained.
• Improve cost savings and price – volume – mix analysis and implement data analytics tools and reports to support business leaders’ strategic decisions.
• Launch new projects mainly focused on indirect costs to achieve savings and synergies across the business lines.
• Payroll and HR administration
• Support payroll and HR administration and the implementation of a payroll system, along with the Payroll Manager.
• Set up payroll processes from scratch, describing tasks, controls, and designing the task distribution and organization between the business lines and the service centre.
• Finance IT
• Define and manage all relevant IT projects in the area of Finance and Purchasing.
• Define, implement and ensure the application of optimised and harmonised processes in line with the Group standard in the area of Finance and Purchasing.
• Support the integration of new entities and improve the integration process from an IT perspective.
• Lunch new IT-related projects with a strong focus on optimisation and automation.
• Driving the implementation of standard processes and systems
• Active contribution to and validation of the design of standard Group-wide Finance & Purchasing processes.
• Drive the implementation of these standard processes, KPIs and controls across the different businesses and functions.
• Driving the integration of newly acquired entities, improving the process and reducing integration time

Qualifications

We are looking for someone with strong leadership skills who is not afraid to stimulate open communication. Driven by the passion to succeed, you should not be afraid to challenge the “status quo”.

In addition, as a finance professional, you should be a very structured, accurate, highly reliable, strong leader, as well as a hands-on team player. We are looking for someone with the ability to dive into the right level of details when needed, as well as to create and follow a vision.

Ideally, you should be educated up to Master’s level in finance, accounting or equivalent, with a minimum of eight years’ work experience in finance leading multiple teams, including finance, IT, purchasing and payroll. Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 61,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of ca. 900 laboratories in 61 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2022, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.7 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years

jobs_results.description: We are seeking a seasoned and strategic Senior Manager (f/m/d) to lead our Project Management Office (PMO). In this role, you will oversee the successful execution of all capacity expansion projects in Power Transformers Europe, ensuring alignment with company goals, timelines, and budgetary constraints. You will be instrumental in driving efficiency, standardization, and best practices across the different projects. Do you want to help shape the future with us in a continuously evolving environment? Then apply now, we are looking forward to you! Our flexible work practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow. Your responsibilities Managing the Program Management Office for our expansion Projects Leading and motivating a project team, creating, and safeguarding the governance Close cooperation and coordination with internal and external stakeholders in your role as key contact person in... the projects Being the first contact person for the senior management and coordinating the steering committees Track and control project progress Monitor and control project financing, overseeing the status of billing, costs, cash flows and other performance metrics Opportunities - risk management and claim management with respect to contract and process-related disruptive events Initiate sustainable process improvements Your background Successful degree in civil engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or comparable (Master / Dipl.) At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in project management or project execution as well as technical leadership of international project teams Profound knowledge of senior management communication Advanced knowledge in MS Project Certification / advanced training as Senior Project Manager / PMP advantageous Very good communication skills, strong target orientation as well as structured working style and ability to work in a team Intercultural competence and consistent pursuit of set goals as well as assertiveness Fluent in written and spoken English and any other language. Willingness to travel on business of approx. 40% Why join us? You will do interesting and enriching work, as part of a dynamic, passionate, and collaborative team which is committed to innovation, continuous improvement You will be stretched, encouraged, and supported to grow – we pride ourselves on providing strong learning and development opportunities We offer an environment that fosters collaboration, connection, and diversity of thought Our culture is one of a kind: come as you are and bring your unique attributes, passion and drive to the design and management of Pensions & Benefits at Hitachi Energy, contributing to making us ‘the place to be’ and to our purpose of advancing a sustainable energy future for all Flexible working, including hybrid/remote working opportunities A competitive compensation and benefits package
